data.one_liner: Converts numeric values to their Portuguese textual representation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a function that turns a number, typically a monetary amount, into a written Portuguese phrase. Works on all Flutter platforms without additional setup.
use_when: You need to display amounts in words in Portuguese
You want a lightweight, zero‑dependency solution for number‑to‑text conversion
avoid_when: You need highly customizable formatting or performance‑critical conversion
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop
